harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Hardened /tmp and /dev/shm on node1 with noexec,nosuid,nodev via /etc/fstab (tmpfs entries), applied live, verified functionally, then rebooted node1 and confirmed the hardening and system health survived the restart.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline mount state for /tmp and /dev/shm and /etc/fstab on node1
Backed up /etc/fstab
Appended fstab entries: 'tmpfs /tmp tmpfs defaults,nosuid,noexec,nodev 0 0' and 'tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs defaults,nosuid,noexec,nodev 0 0'
Applied live via 'mount /tmp' and 'mount -o remount /dev/shm'
Verified live mount options show nosuid,nodev,noexec on both /tmp and /dev/shm
Functionally verified exec is blocked on /tmp (chmod +x script fails with Permission denied, exit 126)
Captured pre-reboot boot_id baseline
Triggered reboot via 'shutdown -r now' backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec became available again
Confirmed boot_id changed and uptime reset, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified /tmp and /dev/shm mount options and functional exec-block after reboot
Confirmed systemctl is-system-running reports 'running' post-reboot

evidence.summary: Showed /tmp was part of root fs (no separate mount) and /dev/shm was tmpfs with only nosuid,nodev (no noexec); no prior fstab entries for either.
Backed up original fstab, appended tmpfs entries with defaults,nosuid,noexec,nodev for /tmp and /dev/shm, confirmed file contains exactly 3 lines (root + two new entries).

evidence.requirement: Options applied live: noexec, nosuid, nodev on /tmp and /dev/shm
evidence.summary: Remounted /dev/shm and mounted /tmp using fstab entries; findmnt/mount output show rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec on both.

evidence.requirement: Functional proof exec is ignored on /tmp
evidence.summary: Created and chmod +x'd a script in /tmp; execution failed with 'Permission denied', exit code 126, proving noexec is enforced.

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline and boot identity
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 2dffe735-a982-49f0-aa0a-19552507ae73 and confirmed systemctl is-system-running == running before reboot.
Issued backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' on node1; command returned REBOOT_TRIGGERED immediately without hanging.

evidence.requirement: Node restart proof via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Node briefly refused SSH connections (mid-reboot), then came back with a new boot_id d5e76de3-826d-43dd-9f8d-93d7da90f37a, differing from the pre-reboot value, proving an actual restart occurred.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of hardened mounts and service health
evidence.summary: After reboot, fresh uptime confirmed; /tmp and /dev/shm automatically remounted from fstab with nosuid,nodev,noexec; functional test again failed to execute a script in /tmp (exit 126); systemctl is-system-running reported 'running'.

attempts.summary: Hardened /tmp and /dev/shm on node1 with noexec,nosuid,nodev via /etc/fstab (tmpfs entries), applied live, verified functionally, then rebooted node1 and confirmed the hardening and system health survived the restart.
